identity: The Hub 01 Arm Reinforcement Motionframe, or ARM, a powered exoskeleton for the true frontier cyborg.  A metal frame runs along each of your arms and hands, with several straps at critical joints, twisting at the wrist into a glove-like matrix of steel.  The frame has a battery compartment and the elbows and lower arms have clips custom-fit for Hub 01 vambraces.  When powered, your arms are exceptionally stable, reducing firearm recoil by 30% and shot dispersion by 10%.  Moreover, you have better control over thrown objects, allowing you to throw objects 50% further and 25% harder.  Unpowered, they are a significant burden.  Activate them to toggle power.  Requires an XM-ARM Interface bionic to function.
